messages.subject: Web site temporarily down
parts:
Dear list members,

Just a headsup that our mail web site https://distancesampling.org is
temporarily offline. We are working to get it back up as soon as possible.

In the meantime, our workshops pages, at
https://workshops.distancesampling.org/
are still functioning as usual.

With best wishes, Len Thomas
